title: Status page certificate expired
description: The certificate for status.example.com expired because renewal was manual and the reminder was missed.

title: Cache config push evicted all sessions
description: A configuration push changed the eviction setting on every cache node at once with no validation or staged rollout, logging all users out.

title: Reporting database out of connections
description: Dashboards failed to load. A long-running query exhausted the database connection pool for the reporting service.

title: Office VPN concentrator failed over
description: The primary VPN concentrator lost power and the standby took four minutes to take over.
